draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.87, the 185th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 25th of 37 at CB. He went 201st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 passes defended in 2020, 11th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 8 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2022.
